project: Wuxia Life P19 Endgame Echo And Historical Memory Closure
description: Complete wuxia endgame closure by differentiating representative endgame categories, adding profile-first pre-endgame recovery and historical-memory config surfaces, wiring those surfaces through minimal theme-neutral runtime support, upgrading final summaries, and proving the closure pattern with focused validation and endgame optimization without adding UI work, new themes, or a large runtime rewrite.

userStories.title: Audit endgame outcome surfaces
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only audit of current endgame outcome sources so that P19 targets the highest-impact final-life closure gaps first.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit the current sources of endgame outcome, end-of-life state, and final fate signals
Mark each endgame surface as config-driven, partially config-driven, or runtime-bound
Record where current runs end without meaningful endgame differentiation beyond age or route label
Save the audit under docs/test-reports/ or docs/designs/
Do not modify gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Audit late-life callback and closure surfaces

acceptanceCriteria: Audit the current callback or recovery surfaces for relationships, vendettas, faction ties, inheritance lines, and unfinished obligations
Mark each closure surface as config-driven, partially config-driven, or runtime-bound
